name: re8ch-tenant
description: Discover current tenant self-service capabilities and reviewed workflows before using RE8CH resource tools.

interface.shortDescription: Discover and use your tenant's live self-service capabilities.
interface.longDescription: Start with tenant_self_service_capabilities for current resource operations and Ready namespaces, then dynamic_skill_search for reviewed internal workflows. Static tool listings are entry points, not a complete capability catalog. OAuth and the active organization determine the resource scope; grants and roles determine allowed operations.
defaultPrompt: Discover the self-service capabilities and reviewed workflows available to my active organization.
Plan this tenant service before creating it.
List my tenant resources and their usage.
